Name: Robert Morrison
Summary: Scottish missionary who reached Canton in 1807 as the first Protestant missionary to China, working under East India Company cover and in defiance of Chinese bans on teaching the language to foreigners.
Contribution: Opened China to Protestant missions, translated the whole Bible into Chinese, and compiled the first major Chinese-English dictionary.
KeyWorks: A Dictionary of the Chinese Language; Chinese Bible translation
Testimony: He testified to patient, hidden labour: years of language study before a single convert, trusting God with the fruit.
